identity: Duo concertant, Op. 31, by Jean Perrin, not Marcel Perrin
findings: Billaudot identifies the composer as Jean Perrin, for E-flat saxophone and piano; plate GB1733, 32 pages, copyright 1974, ISMN 9790043017332.
The Jean Perrin archive inventory identifies Op. 31, composed Lausanne 1973-74, in two movements: Adagio and Allegro giocoso.
The archive records a Pro Helvetia commission for the 1974 Bordeaux World Saxophone Congress and a Basel premiere on 1 March 1974 by Iwan Roth and Peter Elfer.
Publisher labels it Difficile (cycle 3); no SaxoBrain level is assigned.
